caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a man dressed in formal 19th-century attire. He has short, dark hair and sideburns. The figure is wearing a dark suit with a white shirt and a bow tie, and there are several buttons visible on the shirt. A gold chain, possibly a pocket watch chain, hangs from his waistcoat. His left arm is raised, with the index finger pointing upward, while his right hand is holding a rolled scroll or document. The overall color palette consists of various shades of brown, beige, black, and white, with the background left blank or off-white. The figure appears to be made of wood, as indicated by visible wood grain and chipping on the surface, especially on the lower parts of the torso and hands. The composition presents the figure from the mid-torso upward, facing forward.
title: Figurehead: Abe Lincoln
